facts.frame_material: 500 Series OCLV carbon frame with full-carbon fork; Trek does not publish the exact fiber grade or ply schedule
facts.frame_construction: IsoSpeed carbon chassis with downtube storage, concealed routing, T47 shell, UDH, rack/fender/frame-bag mounts and removable front-derailleur hanger
facts.stiffness_evidence: IsoSpeed is documented as a vibration-isolating comfort feature; no measured exact-SL5 frame stiffness or attributable independent deflection result was found
facts.complete_weight_basis: Authorized-retailer exact 2026 trim, size ML, with TLR sealant and no tubes; pedals are not included
facts.drivetrain: SRAM Apex XPLR AXS electronic 1×12, 40T crank and 11–44T cassette
